name: Infoblox — DNS Tunneling (TXT Query Burst)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Query"
| filter xdm.event.description contains " IN TXT "
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter qname = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0)
| alter tunnel_domain = arrayindex(regextract(qname, "([\w\-]+\.[\w\-]+)$"), 0)
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count() as txt_queries, values(xdm.intermediate.ipv4) as resolvers,
       values(tunnel_domain) as domains by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter txt_queries >= 15
| alter resolver_ip = arrayindex(resolvers, 0), tunnel_dom = arrayindex(domains, 0),
        dns_app = "DNS", dns_port = 53
| join type = left (
    dataset = microsoft_windows_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "4624" and _raw_log contains "IpAddress"
    | alter logon_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='IpAddress'>([\d\.]+)<"), 0),
            user_name = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='TargetUserName'>([^<]+)<"), 0),
            host_name = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='WorkstationName'>([^<]+)<"), 0)
    | filter logon_ip != null and user_name != null
    | comp values(user_name) as user_name, values(host_name) as host_name by logon_ip
    | fields logon_ip, user_name, host_name
  ) as wbind wbind.logon_ip = xdm.source.ipv4
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, resolver_ip, tunnel_dom, dns_app, dns_port,
         user_name, host_name, txt_queries
description: High volume of TXT queries from one client — DNS tunneling exfiltration channel.

TA0010 - Exfiltration: T1048.003 - Exfiltration Over Unencrypted Non-C2 Protocol
